observations: Multiple white plastic IBC (intermediate bulk container) totes stacked in an outdoor yard, each inside a metal cage frame
Metal cage frames and bottom pallet frames show visible surface rust in photos 0 and 1
No capacity markings, batch codes, or manufacturer plates are legible in any photo
Ground is bare earth/mud, items stored outdoors exposed to weather
Watermark 'PASTECH GLOBAL TECHNICAL' overlaid on photos 1-3, suggesting a dealer/reseller stock photo rather than a photo of the specific unit being sold
No single unit is singled out, numbered, or tagged as 'this is the one for sale'

identity.kind: 1000L IBC tank (intermediate bulk container, plastic tote in steel cage on pallet)

claims.evidence: No volume markings or capacity label readable in any photo; size looks consistent with a standard IBC but cannot be confirmed
Subjective marketing claim; no stress test, leak test, or close-up of tank wall condition shown

risks.risk: Cage and pallet frame rust could mean structural weakness or long outdoor exposure
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the cage welds/corners and the pallet base of the specific unit being sold
risks.if_unproven: priced as used/worn condition, not as new or near-new

risks.risk: Inner plastic bottle may be cracked, UV-degraded, or discolored, which is not visible in wide shots
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the plastic bottle surface, especially near seams and base, plus a water-fill or leak test clip
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unknown, worst case treated as leaking/compromised

risks.risk: Unknown prior contents (IBCs are often reused from chemical, food, or industrial liquids) which affects safe reuse value
risks.proof: Photo of any UN code, chemical label, or previous-content sticker on the tote
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown history, not as food-grade safe

risks.risk: Photos may be generic stock/dealer images, not the exact unit the buyer would receive
risks.proof: A fresh photo of the specific unit with today's date/note visible, or a video walk-around
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unverified against actual unit received

proof_requests: Close-up photo of one specific tote (cage corners, pallet, and plastic bottle surface) that will actually be sold
Photo of any capacity/volume marking or manufacturer plate on the tote
Photo or note of any prior content label / UN hazard code on the bottle
Short video showing the tote being moved or filled to check for leaks or cracks
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used 1000L IBC tank sold from bulk yard stock, so it can be priced at worst case (used, rusted cage, unverified inner bottle integrity and prior contents) even though several condition claims remain unproven.
